facts.en: Completed a craft-studio support certificate at Fictional Claywillow Centre in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构陶柳中心完成手工工作室支持证书课程。

facts.en: Paid studio assistant at Fictional Kilnpetal Workshop from 2024-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-02 至 2026-08 在虚构窑瓣工坊任有薪工作室助理。

facts.en: Prepared labeled work shelves and matched learner pieces to collection tickets.
facts.zh: 准备有标签的作品货架，并将学员作品与领取票据匹配。

facts.en: Recorded receipt dates and the firing-stage status supplied by the studio technician.
facts.zh: 记录收件日期及工作室技术员提供的烧制阶段状态。

facts.en: Grouped unfired pieces for technician review according to the studio’s supplied handling instructions.
facts.zh: 依据工作室提供的搬运说明，将未烧制作品分组供技术员审核。

facts.en: The technician selected firing schedules, loaded the kiln and authorized unloading; the candidate maintained the collection records.
facts.zh: 技术员选择烧制程序、装窑并授权出窑；候选人维护领取记录。

facts.en: Sent collection messages only after the technician marked pieces as ready for release.
facts.zh: 仅在技术员将作品标记为可交付后发送领取信息。

facts.en: Revised a collection-ticket layout with the studio manager in 2025-03.
facts.zh: 2025-03 与工作室经理共同修订领取票据版式。

facts.en: Personally added shelf-location and notification-date boxes; the manager set the retention policy.
facts.zh: 个人添加货架位置及通知日期栏；保管政策由经理制定。

facts.en: In a 2025-04 shelf audit, 57 of 60 sampled pieces had a matching collection ticket; 3 needed staff follow-up.
facts.zh: 2025-04 货架审核中，60 件抽样作品有 57 件具备匹配领取票据；3 件需要工作人员跟进。

facts.en: The audit did not assess the pieces’ artistic quality or firing-defect rate.
facts.zh: 该审核未评估作品艺术质量或烧制缺陷率。

facts.en: Checked clay-bag and packaging stock against reorder levels supplied by the manager.
facts.zh: 依据经理提供的补货水平检查陶泥袋及包装材料库存。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet location filters, printed shelf labels and approved collection-message templates.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格位置筛选、纸质货架标签及获批领取信息模板。

facts.en: Attended an internal studio-access induction in 2024-02; no independent kiln-operation authorization was granted.
facts.zh: 2024-02 参加内部工作室访问入职培训；未获独立操作陶窑授权。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Acorn Craft Weekend in 2023-06, helping set up display tables and pack exhibitors’ unsold work.
facts.zh: 2023-06 在虚构橡果手工周末做志愿者，协助布置展台并包装参展者未售作品。

facts.en: Co-created a tabletop display for that volunteer event with 2 friends; the candidate made the paper labels.
facts.zh: 与 2 名朋友共同为该志愿活动制作桌面展示；候选人制作纸质标签。

facts.en: Takes recreational wheel-throwing classes and keeps personal practice bowls; no commercial ceramics sales are recorded.
facts.zh: 参加休闲拉坯课程并保留个人练习碗；未记录商业陶艺销售。

facts.en: Photographed personal practice pieces for a dated sketch-and-photo notebook in 2025.
facts.zh: 2025 年为个人练习作品拍照，制作带日期的素描与照片笔记。

facts.en: Enjoys carving soft-stamp patterns for paper craft projects.
facts.zh: 爱好为纸艺项目雕刻软质印章图案。

facts.en: Prepared end-of-day handovers listing uncollected work and pieces awaiting technician review.
facts.zh: 准备日终交接，列明未领取作品及等待技术员审核的作品。

facts.en: The supplied records do not establish teaching responsibility or independent glaze formulation.
facts.zh: 所提供记录未确立教学职责或独立配制釉料的经历。
